_about: look: the whole doll lifted out of the dark (gain multiplies, gamma below 1 opens the shadows), no coloured rim (D81). sheet_parts: true draws the parts from parts_dir/full with mipmaps and smoothing, sharp at any camera zoom (D84); false draws the parts baked to the game size, pixel by pixel. The heroine as a cutout doll (task Д5, D77). Parts are cut from docs/art/heroine/character_parts_hq.jpg by tools/cut_heroine_parts.py. Every length is in pixels of the part pictures; scale turns them into game pixels. at: where the joint sits in the parent part's picture (for a part without parent: from the feet, the rig's origin). pivot: the same joint in the part's own picture. z: drawing order, higher in front. size: draw the part this many times larger than on the sheet (default 1). far: the far side of the body, drawn darker. Poses give each part's angle in degrees, positive clockwise; lift moves the whole body up in part pixels. soles: points of the boot soles; every pose is lowered or raised so the lowest of them stands on the floor. run: the cycle of poses by the distance walked (cycle_px game pixels for all keys, so the feet do not slide), min_speed_px: slower is standing, blend_seconds: how fast she goes from one pose to the next. air: in the air the pose blends from rise to fall by the vertical speed (blend_speed_px: the speed of the full fall pose), and the body keeps its pelvis where it stands in idle instead of the soles. overlays: short poses laid over the run or idle for the parts they name — press (E) and land; seconds in all, in_seconds and out_seconds to blend in and out; land plays only after a fall faster than min_speed_px. exit: the walk out of the doorway at the start of a level: the exit pose and the dark tint fade out over the walk-in. light: the gauntlet's light on her own body only (D76), forward and rewind strength, radius_px in game pixels around the strip's center, and under Shift (D80.1, as the 4th heroine of the Night shop mock-up): tint, an even glow of the time colour over her whole figure, and motes: count small dots of the time colour (size_min_px..size_max_px) that start from_min_px..from_max_px away, spiral in (swirl radians on the way, flatten squeezes the spiral up and down) and vanish in the gauntlet hz times a second, faint far away and bright near it; they light nothing (D76). Д5.1 (20.11.2026): tint and rewind are weaker (D86); breath: in forward time the strip and the light on her slowly dim to low and come back every seconds (D86). threads: "wind into the glove" (D85, D85.3) instead of the glow along the screen edges: under Shift, after start_seconds, first threads come in and one more every every_seconds up to max, each fading in over fade_in_seconds; a trip takes travel_seconds of every period_seconds and starts from its own point margin_px beyond the screen edge, spread evenly round the edge by the golden ratio from start_edge (0..1 clockwise from the top left corner), fixed on the screen for the trip; it flies straight at the gauntlet, lingering at the edge and rushing in at the end (pull below 1), and hooks in by swirl radians only at the very end (curl: the higher, the later); trail: the length of a thread as a part of its way, drawn in segments; glow_px, edge_px and core_px: the widths of the faint wide glow, the body and the core in screen pixels near the gauntlet, edge_scale times wider at the screen edge, back to normal by shrink_until of the way; at the edge a thread is only a wide glow at edge_alpha of its brightness, and it gets brighter and sharper (the core shows) until sharp_at of the way; alpha: how bright they are at most.
